news.title: Zantat Holdings Reallocates RM1 Million IPO Proceeds To Working Capital, Extends Utilisation Period

recent_en: ZANTAT recently reallocated RM1 million of IPO proceeds to working capital and extended the utilisation period; meanwhile, Executive Director Chan Bin Iuan acquired 59,100 shares during the closed period. The latest quarterly report (for the period ended 30 June 2026) has been released.
notable_en: Reallocated RM1 million of IPO proceeds to working capital and extended the utilisation period.
Executive Director Chan Bin Iuan acquired 59,100 shares at RM0.135 per share during the closed period.
